handbook.foreword_personal_section: Jake added a personal connections section to the Foreword after the third paragraph, before 'If you are reading this as an operator...' Covers: Burlington Route car (great uncle Richard Carlton Overton, historian/author of 'The Burlington Route'), Dew Drop Inn (father Dick Overton, Giants games, Weehawken NJ bar by the river), Elk River Valley (Steamboat Springs inspiration, son Cole, Yampa Valley Bank, railroad history 1909), Federal Building (son Charlie at government contractor with discreet offices worldwide), Overton Coach (William Dayton Overton 1870s-80s lightweight coaches, coincidental name). Closing line: 'Somehow, it just felt right to use a car named after an Overton on this railroad, even if the connection is coincidental.' Transition line added before 'If you are reading this as an operator...': 'The railroad does not need these connections to run. But they are part of why it was worth building.'
